name: sql-stored
title: SQL Stored Procedure
description: Perform SQL queries as a JDBC Stored Procedures using Spring JDBC.
label: database

properties.name: template
properties.description: Sets the stored procedure template to perform. You can externalize the template by using file: or classpath: as prefix and specify the location of the file.

properties.name: dataSource
properties.description: Sets the DataSource to use to communicate with the database.

properties.name: function
properties.description: Whether this call is for a function.

properties.name: noop
properties.description: If set, will ignore the results of the stored procedure template and use the existing IN message as the OUT message for the continuation of processing

properties.name: outputHeader
properties.description: Store the template result in a header instead of the message body. By default, outputHeader == null and the template result is stored in the message body, any existing content in the message body is discarded. If outputHeader is set, the value is used as the name of the header to store the template result and the original message body is preserved.

properties.name: useMessageBodyForTemplate
properties.description: Whether to use the message body as the stored procedure template and then headers for parameters. If this option is enabled then the template in the uri is not used.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: templateOptions
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Configures the Spring JdbcTemplate with the key/values from the Map. This is a multi-value option with prefix: template.
